extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 03f2b9959f3611e4c90bdf6b79de906aebb1c9c6d573ad2d462d7456f381deb7; the supplied identity is LCSC C18199095, MPN M4, manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The datasheet is a family sheet for M1 through M7. The exact M4 column was examined; the visible manufacturer is Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.

Fig. 3 is a grouped typical forward-voltage curve for M1-M7 at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle. The points are direct digitizations of the supplied vector plot at stated voltage positions; no intermediate points were synthesized or interpolated.

Fig. 4 is a grouped typical reverse-characteristics plot for M1-M7 at Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 100 degC. The plotted reverse current is represented as positive magnitude in amperes; points are direct digitizations of the supplied vector curves with no intermediate points synthesized or interpolated.

The M4 electrical-characteristics rows give maximum VF = 1.0 V at IF = 1.0 A, maximum IR1 = 2 microA at VR = VDC = 400 V and TA = 25 degC, separate maximum IR2 = 200 microA at VR = VDC = 400 V and TA = 125 degC, and typical CJ = 18 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz. SI conversions are used in specs: 2 microA = 2e-6 A and 18 pF = 1.8e-11 F.

Absolute maximum ratings for M4 include VRRM = 400 V, VRMS = 280 V, VDC = 400 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A at 60 Hz sinewave with resistance load, IFSM = 30.0 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, and Tj/Tstg = -55 to +150 degC. These ratings are limits and are not treated as breakdown data.
The supplied datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification. VRRM and VDC ratings are blocking ratings, not measured breakdown data.
